# kamaken

## Overview

- useful functions only for the author of this package

This package contains functions customized for the author’s workflow.
This package could be suddenly modified for the author’s convinience.

## Installation

``` r
if(!require(remotes)) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Kentaro-Kamada/kamaken")

library(kamaken)
```

## Usage

Under Construction

# Package index

## All functions

- [`describe_d()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/describe_d.md)
  : Show Discriptive statistics for categorical variables

- [`describe_d_()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/describe_d_.md)
  :

  Show Discriptive statistics for categorical variables. The output is
  formatted with `gt` so that you can easily include it in Rmarkdown
  documents.

- [`gcomp_jack()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/gcomp_jack.md)
  : Estimate the causal effect by G-computation with jackknife variance
  estimation.

- [`haven_value_label()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/haven_value_label.md)
  : Create a list of value labels from SPSS or Stata data

- [`haven_variable_label()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/haven_variable_label.md)
  : Create a list of variable labels from SPSS or Stata data

- [`lem()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/lem.md) :

  Activate LEM through
  [`system2()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/system2.html).

- [`my_cross()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/my_cross.md)
  : Cross tabulations for categorical variables

- [`my_cross_plot()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/my_cross_plot.md)
  : Generate a plot converted from a contingency table.

- [`p_star()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/p_star.md)
  : convert p value to stars in a tibble.

- [`pdf_ocr()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/pdf_ocr.md)
  : This function needs some outside modules tesseract, poppler and
  qpdf. These can be installed from homebrew.

- [`poLCA_BLRT()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/poLCA_BLRT.md)
  :

  Goodness of Fit of LCA Models with `poLCA_result`

- [`poLCA_check_class()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/poLCA_check_class.md)
  :

  format a result of latent class analysis with `poLCA_result`

- [`poLCA_result()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/poLCA_result.md)
  :

  Useful short cut for
  [`poLCA::poLCA`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/poLCA/man/poLCA.html).

- [`pool_rubin()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/pool_rubin.md)
  : Integration of estimation results by multiple imputation method
  following rubin's rule.

- [`rdunif()`](https://kentaro-kamada.github.io/kamaken/reference/rdunif.md)
  : Generate random sample from a discrete uniform distribution
